monsters.name: Natasha
monsters.description:
A fast-moving magical cat. Once a powerful wizard's familiar, Natasha was abandoned after her master was consumed by the very necromantic forces he sought to control. Now she patrols the dungeon, taking a bloody vengeance with spell and claw upon any adventurer who crosses her path.

This cat doesn't have nine lives, but just one death isn't going to be enough to put her down for good.

Max HP: ~15      Will: +          AC: +          EV: +++                        
Threat: High    Class: Natural  Size: V. Small  Int: Human      
Speed: 100% (travel: 125%) (normally travels faster than you)

You have about 51% to hit with your +0 hand axe and 40% to hit with your headbutt.
She has about 69% to hit you.

Attack  Max Damage  
Claw    10          

She can see invisible.
Despite her appearance, she can open doors.
To read a description, press the key listed above. (AdB) indicates damage (the sum of A B-sided dice), (x%) indicates the chance to defeat your Will, and (y) indicates the spell range; shown in red if you are in range.
